notes: Dates are US/Eastern calendar days. CPI/NFP 08:30 ET, FOMC 14:00 ET, Jackson Hole ~10:00 ET — same YYYY-MM-DD in Europe/Bucharest.
scheduled = known-in-advance USD prints that routinely spike gold. all = scheduled plus unscheduled shocks.
FOMC dates: Federal Reserve official calendar (decision day). CPI/NFP dates: BLS via ALFRED actual release dates (seasonal-factor and CES-benchmark-only days omitted).
Oct 2025 US government shutdown delayed/canceled several BLS prints; those rows use the actual published date.
Shock dates for weekend events use the first FX session (usually Monday).
Edit this file to add/remove days, then re-run with news_mode=filter to test.
